scope: Current Daily-hosted versions of the eight additional draft games; main-game authorization remains separately unresolved

documents.finding: The current terms restrict game-image extraction/recording and redistribution and do not grant this project a media-reuse license. They also distinguish personal play from redistribution of Daily content.
Daily identifies these implementations as its own designs/code/copy, distinct from similarly named originals. A creator video of the original does not establish Daily-version equivalence.

decision: Do not adopt or publish Daily screenshots, downloaded covers or third-party artwork. Internal diagnostic evidence is not site media. Continue independent video and input research; evaluate replacements against their own primary rights evidence.
limits: This is a source-policy finding, not a general legal opinion or a claim that a YouTube embed license authorizes game-image republication.
